mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows the permission matrix to become unconstrained; bank staff could then be granted permission to submit applications (or customers granted decision-making rights), violating least privilege.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermissionMatrixViolation { BankStaffRole -> PostApplications in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this constraint allows multiple pending applications for the same customer, directly violating FR-005's one-in-flight rule and the business model.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OnePendingViolation { some disj a1, a2: LoanApplication | a1.customer = a2.customer and a1.status = PendingReview and a2.status = PendingReview }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this constraint allows applications to exist without required audit events (e.g., submitted event missing, or decision events missing), breaking audit trail integrity required by FR-016.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditViolation { some a: LoanApplication | no e: a.audit_events | e.event_type = Submitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this constraint allows the same application to have multiple decisions recorded, enabling the concurrent decision race condition to occur and violating SC-005.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MultiDecisionViolation { some disj d1, d2: Decision | d1.application = d2.application }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this constraint allows an application to be both decided and still pending, contradicting FR-011 (immutability once approved/rejected).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ImmutabilityViolation { some a: LoanApplication, d: a.decision | a.status = PendingReview }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this constraint allows audit events to be attributed to the wrong actor (e.g., a submitted event attributed to a staff member instead of the customer), breaking audit integrity and attribution correctness required by FR-016.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MisattributionViolation { some a: LoanApplication, e: a.audit_events | e.event_type = Submitted and e.actor != a.customer }
